story_text.value:
Hi HN,

I am Shikhar, founder of Binary.

It's an applicant tracking system (ATS) for startups that is MCP friendly and comes with a free forever plan.

It can do a lot of things - creating hiring forms, career pages, screening candidates, tracking the hiring funnel, scheduling interviews and more.

I decided to build it because old-school ATS tools felt very slow, outdated and expensive. In fact, many of them don't even allow using the tool without speaking to sales. We not just have a self-serve, but the AI even sets up some sample data so that you can play around instantly.

We've been heads down working with a lot of startups who all wanted a more AI-first ATS, and seeing some early success.

This is my first time posting on HN. If there are any founders/recruiters, I'd love to get your honest feedback or thoughts on the tool.

story_text.value:
I use Loom all the time for quick video notes. But on Loom’s free plan, a video can be at most 5 minutes, and you can’t download your own recordings. Paid plans start at $180 a year per person.

So I built Clippa: a simpler, much cheaper alternative.

Clippa records your screen and camera right in your browser and hands back one finished video. No app to install, no editing, no meeting that could have been a 90-second video.

- Record and download for free, as much as you like, no account needed. - Share a link to your recording, free to start. - Pro is $20 a year: 60-minute recordings, no Clippa branding, and room for all your videos.

Try it here: https://tryclippa.com

story_text.value:
Hi HN, I'm Sanjay. I've been travelling since I moved from Pakistan to Stockholm in 2008; I live in Sydney now. My trips were scattered across a spreadsheet, airline apps, old inboxes and a photo library, so I built Trvlrr to hold all of it. It's how I plan all my future trips and look back at all my past ones. Forward a booking email (flights, trains, hotels, tours) to a private address and it lands on the right day of the right trip.

Every past trip is kept, with stats that count only what actually happened.

Photos are filed by trip and searchable by what's in them.

It's in Claude's and ChatGPT's and Raycast directories, so you can install it and use it via MCP: ask "when was I last in Lisbon?" or "add this hotel to my Japan trip". In fact, this is how I imported all of my travel history.

It's been a fun challenge working out the intricate details and adding features I'd always wanted in an app like this.

iPhone app plus a full web app (Android is under development). Free covers everything for few trips, you can add more via mcp to onboard but the app should be functional. No ads, no data selling.

Try without signing up: https://trvlrr.app/tools/countries-visited-map

I'd love for you to try it and send me any feedback you have.

Cheers, Sanjay

title.value: Show HN: I built Trvlrr, home for all your travels
